title: Biological Control, Compliance, Isolation, CAPA, and IPM Audit Workbook
purpose: Support biological-control evaluation, pesticide compliance documentation, isolation/waste handling, CAPA, and whole-program IPM audits.

sections.title: Biological Control Deployment Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Was the biological control matched to target biology, timing, and crop environment, and did monitoring show a useful effect?

sections.title: Pesticide Label and Resistance-Management Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Is the proposed use explicitly lawful and label-compliant, and does the resistance plan avoid unnecessary repeated selection pressure?

sections.title: Isolation, Removal, and Waste Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Did removal contain biological risk without creating a new transfer pathway?

sections.title: Plant-Health CAPA Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Did CAPA reduce recurrence risk, or did it only correct the visible event?

sections.title: IPM Program Audit
sections.decisionPrompt: Which recurring failure shows that the IPM system needs redesign rather than another isolated treatment?

qualityRules: Do not provide pesticide rates outside controlling labels.
Record biological-control compatibility and follow-up counts.
Close CAPA only after effectiveness verification.
Audit trends and recurring failures, not merely record presence.
